## Why

Briefly summarize why the change is needed. Use bullet points.

## What

In bullet points, concisely describe what updates have been made.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor / code quality
- [ ] Other

## Checklist

- [ ] I have added or updated tests that cover my changes.
- [ ] `make check` passes locally (formatting, linting, type checking).
- [ ] `make test` passes locally.
- [ ] I have updated `README.md` if this PR adds or changes CLI functionality.
- [ ] I have updated relevant docstrings/documentation.
- [ ] If this PR contains code changes, I have incremented the version number in `pyproject.toml` following semantic versioning.

## Additional Notes

Anything else reviewers must know: design tradeoffs, follow-up work, etc.
